faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) for a project-based Junior Research Fellow position in Punjab.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name advertised is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the AR&DB sponsored project numbered ARDB/SP/4513/2261.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in IIT Ropar JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for IIT Ropar JRF?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Junior Research Fellow position is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for IIT Ropar JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech in Mechanical and M.Tech in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering/Applied Mechanics with a GATE score, or a B.Tech/B.E in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering with a GATE score.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Ropar JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is entirely online through the Google Form link provided in the official project advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Ropar JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIT Ropar JRF posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or stipend for IIT Ropar JRF?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a salary/stipend as per AR&DB rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at https://www.iitrpr.ac.in and check the Important Links section for notification and application details.
